div.l: A vernykele hadde he sowyd vp on hese cappe
Hese walet be foryn hȳm in hese lappe
Bret ful of pardoūn come frōm rome hot
A uoys he hath as smal as haþ a got
No berd hadde he ne neủere schulde haue
As smothe it was / as it were late schaue
I trowe he were a geldyns or a mare
But of hese craft frōm berewik in to ware
Ne was swich a noþ̉er pardoūnnere
For in his male he hadde a pilwe bere
Wich þᵗat he seyde was oure lady ueyl
He seyde he hadde a gobet of þe seyl
That seynt petyr hadde whan þᵗat he wente
Vp on þe se tyl in god that god hȳm hente
He hadde a cros / of latoun . ful of stonys
And in a glas he hadde piggis bonys
But wᵗith þese relikys whan þᵗat he fond.
A poủere persoūn vp on lond
Vp on a day he gat hȳm more moneye
Than þe persoūn gat in moneþis tweye
And þus wᵗith feynede flaterye ⁊and Iapis
He made the persoūn ⁊and the puple hese apys
But trewely to tellyn at the laste
He was in cherche a noble ecclesiaste
Wel couthe he rede a story story xxxxx lessoūn or a story
But aldirbest he song an offratory
For wel he wiste whan that song was sunge
He muste preche ⁊and wel affile hyse tunge
To wȳnne sylủer as he wel couthe
Therfore he song the meryerely ⁊and loude
Now haue I told ȝow sothly in a clause
The estat tharay the noūmbre ⁊and ek the cause
Whi assemblid was this cūmpayny
In southwerk at this ientil ostelry
That hyȝte the tabbard faste by þe belle
But now is tyme to ȝow for to telle
